entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By way of present petition under Articles 14, 19 and 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has made the following prayers.

"(A) YOUR LORDSHIPS be pleased to issue appropriate writ, order or direction quashing and setting aside the impugned award dated 23/04/2020 (Annexure "A")
and action on the part of respondent authorities as being illegal, arbitrary,

unjustified, unreasonable, contrary to the provisions of act, 1894, against the principles of natural justice, as also violative of Art. 14 & 19 of the Constitution of India;
Pidabhai Vechalabhai Rathwa vs State Of Gujarat on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183722469/
1 C/SCA/9017/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/06/2023 (B) YOUR LORDSHIPS be pleased to stay the implementation, operation and execution of the impugned award and further be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to pass adequate compensation to the petitioner for the subject land,
pending the admission and hearing, of this petition, in the interest of justice;"

entities.text: Pidabhai Vechalabhai Rathwa vs State Of Gujarat on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having heard the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties and in view of efficacious alternative remedy available under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, present petition is not entertained and is hereby disposed of.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is made clear that this Court has not gone into the merits of the case.
It would be open for the petitioner to take appropriate proceedings available under the law.
Present petition is disposed of accordingly.
